day_shape: 80 items: Quad (US/UK/France/Germany) pressed Iran at IAEA Board, Trump reported weighing fresh strikes on Iran with Netanyahu pushing a 4-7 day campaign, Houthi missile damaged Riyadh's PIF Tower, IDF crossed Gaza's Yellow Line to demolish a tunnel, and US sanctioned a Hezbollah front network.

threads.label: Quad pressure at IAEA Board
threads.summary: The US, UK, France and Germany issued a joint statement to the IAEA Board of Governors pressing Iran to readmit inspectors to sites bombed by the US and Israel. Iran's representative said IAEA information 'will certainly be used for further attacks' and signalled it would reconsider access and cooperation.

threads.label: Trump weighs fresh Iran offensive
threads.summary: Reports said Trump is weighing another round of extensive strikes on Iran, with Netanyahu pushing a four-to-seven-day joint air campaign, while Trump told Fox News the US would 'see what happens after New Year's' and would not ask Xi or Putin for help. Mossad chief reportedly advocated strikes as Gulf leaders urged Trump to avoid an attack.

threads.label: Iranian retaliation threats and plots
threads.summary: Iran International reported Tehran threatening regional oil infrastructure, wider missile strikes and revenge for Khamenei's killing, with officials widening threats after a NYT report on dams; Treasury Secretary Bessent's relocation to a military base was linked to intelligence about an alleged Iranian chemical plot. CENTCOM rejected online claims that US personnel had been wounded in Iranian attacks as false, and the IRGC spokesman said any US strike on Iranian dams would be met in kind.

threads.label: Gaza: Yellow Line operation and Hamas strikes
threads.summary: The IDF crossed the Yellow Line into central Gaza's Bureij and Nuseirat to demolish a tunnel it said posed an immediate threat, completing the operation within a day with prior civilian warnings. Separate strikes killed two Hamas platoon commanders in Khan Younis and Jabalia as Israel stepped up targeting of Hamas commanders.

threads.label: Houthi strikes and Yemen front
threads.summary: A Houthi missile damaged Saudi Arabia's PIF Tower in Riyadh's financial district, and Saudi civil defence later said the danger had passed in southern cities placed on alert. UNICEF said at least 64 children had been killed and 64 injured in Yemen since hostilities escalated on 3 September, while Iran's foreign minister requested an emergency OIC meeting on Gaza and Defa Press claimed Yemeni forces had advanced on the southern coastline.

threads.label: US sanctions and Iraq militia standoff
threads.summary: The US Treasury sanctioned the Wa Ta'awanu Association, a Hezbollah front charity in southern Lebanon, along with two brothers accused of aiding the group. In Iraq, the army awaited orders to move on a Kataib Hezbollah stronghold south of Baghdad after IRGC Quds Force commander Esmail Qaani met PM Ali al-Zaidi.

threads.label: Iran domestic strain and repression
threads.summary: Iran International reported a judge, his wife and three-year-old son shot dead in northwest Iran, hundreds of writers calling for a halt to poet Peyman Farahavar's execution, students complaining of heating restrictions in cold schools, and severe gas-driven pressure on the steel and cement sectors. The UN Third Committee approved a country-specific human rights resolution on Iran among five such resolutions.

Yemen's Ministry of Foreign Affairs sent notes to the UN Secretary General, the President of the UN General Assembly, the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, permanent members of the Security Council, the Human Rights Council, the European Union, the Arab League, the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation and the African Union regarding the continuation of war crimes committed by Saudi Arabia in Yemen. A source close to Yemeni armed forces in an interview with Defence Press international correspondent, referring to recent advances by the Yemeni army and popular forces, reported that Yemeni forces are attempting to consolidate their positions on the southern Yemen coastline. Clashes continue in southern Yemen and the Yemeni armed forces are fortifying their positions. Saudi forces continue to suffer heavy defeats on the southern front in Yemen. It is worth noting that the Yemeni army and popular forces have recently carried out operations in several provinces of this country including Taiz.

events.summary_en: Mearsheimer: Currently there is only one regional winner and that is Iran. Iranians are masters of chess, they know how to read their opponent's moves, and this is what they did in the last two rounds with Trump. They designed the Strait of Hormuz equation, they manipulate the price of petrol, the Republican party in America has fallen apart and all members of his cabinet have been sent to shelters inside American military bases. Even if Israel and America resort to a third, fourth or fifth round of attacks, defeating Iran with air strikes is impossible.

events.title: Two Hamas commanders were killed in separate strikes in the Gaza Strip yesterday, the military announces. One strike in southern Gaza's Khan Younis on Tuesday killed Ashraf Nayef Muhammad Tabasi, a platoon commander in Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade, according to the IDF. A second strike on Tuesday in northern Gaza's Jabalia killed Saber Nayef Mahmoud Nabhan, identified by the IDF as a platoon commander in Hamas's West Jabalia Battalion. The army says both operatives were advancing attacks on troops and Israeli civilians and acted to restore Hamas's capabilities, "in systematic violation of the ceasefire."
